newsitem.title: GERMANY: Karstadt board to review Deuss' position.
newsitem.headline: Karstadt board to review Deuss' position.

text.p: The supervisory board of German retailer Karstadt AG will meet this month to take a formal decision to dismiss chief executive Walter Deuss, weekly news magazine Wirtschaftswoche said on Wednesday.

Wirtschaftswoche, which last week ran a story speculating that Deuss would have to make way for logistics director Klaus Eierhoff, said board chief Guido Sandler would next week inform staff leaders of the planned decision by key shareholders.
Deuss has come under criticism for failing to turn around the Karstadt group's department store business and shareholders -- including Deutsche Bank and Commerzbank -- have pressed for his departure.
Sandler represents the interests of the Hertie foundation, which is Karstadt's largest shareholder with a 30 percent stake.
No comment could immediately be obtained from Karstadt.
